name: Lucas Papademos

summary.text: Lucas Papademos was Vice-President of the European Central Bank from June 2002 to May 2010 and served as Prime Minister of Greece from November 2011 to May 2012 at the head of a national unity government formed during the debt crisis.

sources.title: Papademos to take over Greek premiership

facts.claim: Papademos was Vice-President of the European Central Bank from 1 June 2002 to 31 May 2010.
facts.quote: June 1, 2002-May 31, 2010 - Vice President of the European Central Bank.

facts.claim: Greek party negotiations agreed on 10 November 2011 that Papademos would take over the premiership.
facts.quote: it was agreed on Thursday (10 November) that Papademos would take over the premiership.
